ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game sprite for the Coulter seed drill: a trailed grain seed drill that a farm tractor pulls by its drawbar to sow a field in neat rows, for a hard-scrabble frontier colony. Draw the DRILL ONLY, with no tractor. Image 1 is our approved tractor that pulls it: match its outline weight, shading, harvest-green and muted yellow palette, tyre treatment and steel grey drawbar drawing only. Do NOT draw a tractor.

Tall canvas, plain pure white background. North facing: the drawbar points to the TOP of the canvas. The drill is centred and fills about four fifths of the canvas width and about four fifths of its height.

Its plan, top to bottom: at the top centre, a narrow steel A-shaped drawbar with a hitch eye at its tip; below it, a wide long seed hopper box running across the canvas with a closed hinged lid, the lid's top a flat green panel with a raised rim and a small walkway step at one end; one wheel on each side of the hopper; below the hopper, across the full width, a single row of evenly spaced small steel coulter discs set at a slight angle, each with a short seed tube above it; at the very bottom, a thin row of steel covering harrow tines.

Palette as materials: harvest-green hopper and lid, a steel grey drawbar, frame, discs and tines, dark rubber tyres, one muted yellow accent stripe along the hopper.

Style: a top-down sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No tractor, no seed spilling, no soil, no crop, no people, no dust, mud or damage, no text, letters, numbers or logos. No floor, ground, field, shadow outside the drill, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
